candidates.change_summary: Replace the revert condition so SetMinSum always sets MinSum without checking initialized.
Replace MinSum assignment with a different value (e.g., _val+1) so the stored MinSum diverges.
Remove the require check in the modifier so SetMinSum can be called even when locked_, changing its behavior under reentrant calls.
Replace 'locked_ = true' with 'locked_ = false' so the lock is never set, changing which calls to SetMinSum succeed.
Remove the final 'locked_ = false' so after one call, subsequent calls to SetMinSum always fail, changing observable state updates.
